notes.title: Module 10 Released!
notes.content:
Hey there Rocketeers!

Hope you're having a great fall!  On our end, we have thrown together a few special surprises for our 10th update to the game.

These include:
 - New Rockets: Would you like to pilot something small and maneuverable?  Or how about the long rocket, fastest in the fleet?  Or maybe the twin rocket, which can be a bit slow, but packs a major punch!
 - New AI: Stanley has some new siblings and each of the new rockets has it's own AIs.  Stella is a vicious fighter who pilots the small rocket.  Scooby runs away from everything and pilots the long rocket.  And Scott Manley won't take his finger off the trigger and pilots the twin rocket.
 - New Powerups: Big shot! Triple shot! Or maybe just be invincible for a while and try and ram your opponent!
 - New Level: The Screaming Whale has traveled to a dangerous part of the galaxy and come loaded to bear.  Be careful in this level because the ship's weapon systems are going to be automatically targeting anyone who flies too close.
 - Bug fixes: Not as exciting, I know, but we need to slip these in somewhere...

Let us know in the forums if you encounter any issues with anything in the game, and keep flying!

notes.title: New Maps and Tournament Modes!
notes.content:
Hi there rocketeers!

It’s been a while, but we have a new build for you, with such updates as:
[list]
    [*]New maps! Sail through the [b]Blank[/b] void, fight in [b]Close Quarters[/b], weave through the [b]Asteroid Field[/b], or climb [b]The Tower[/b] to victory!
    [*]New tournament modes! See who can win the longest in [b]Monarch of the Mountain[/b], or see how many kills you can get in the [b]Elimination[/b] mode!
    [*]Bug fixes, including updates to the controller software and tweaks to resolution selection that should hopefully limit the issues with problematic resolutions. 
[/list]
As always, let us know if you encounter any issues on the forums, and keep flying!

notes.title: Module TWO is Live!
notes.content:
It’s that time again! Here’s a video for the next installment of the Steam-Early-Access version of ROCKETSROCKETSROCKETS:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S2vg9CBLZOE]Module TWO Update video![/url]

What are the highlights of this release?

[list]
[*]MODDING. Our rocket scientists have been working hard to bring you this update that can unleash your creative potential!  Remember back in Module One when we hinted at some new modding features? Those features are now entirely integrated with the Steam Workshop, right inside the game interface! Upload and download mods, rate and rank your favourites, and subscribe to the best to automatically download the latest updates as they happen.
[*]NEW TRACK. Strap on your thrust-vectoring nozzles; you are really going to feel the Gs with the fresh new track from Ben Lam!
[*]BURST FIRE. Each rocket has an experimental new firing mode — holding down the fire button results in a firehose of artillery, but also exposes the ROCKETS to a vulnerable shield-free period.
[/list]

For more details and a complete changelog, see the [url=http://rocketsrocketsrockets.tumblr.com/post/93037433057/module-two]blog post[/url]!
